build_load_pipeline: build a diffusion pipeline with compiled UNet and VAE, optional quantization and fused projections
run_dynamic_quant_filter: run dynamic quantization filter to select eligible Linear modules for int8 dynamic quantization
run_conv_filter: run convolution filter to identify 1x1 Conv2d modules with 128 channels for conversion to linear
build_quantize_unet: build int4 or int8 quantized UNet with torch.compile for accelerated inference
build_compile_vae: build compiled VAE decode with torch channels_last memory format and 1x1 conv-to-linear swap
